name: Fluvoxamine reduces diazepam clearance
actions: Avoid coadministration of fluvoxamine and diazepam when possible.

rationale: Fluvoxamine inhibits oxidative clearance of diazepam and its active metabolite.
Accumulation can increase and prolong sedation.

explanation_template: Fluvoxamine reduces diazepam clearance and can prolong sedation. The fluvoxamine label advises that these drugs should not ordinarily be coadministered.

references.source: DailyMed, Fluvoxamine Maleate Tablets, Drug Interactions
references.citation: Healthy-volunteer coadministration study supports avoiding fluvoxamine with diazepam.
